text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm gonna give it my all today
and make these radishes super tasty~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mirin~, soy sauce~, fried fish cakes~♪
And then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Daikon, the daikon is... Huh? Where is it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...It's not here.
Did I forget to buy it...? *sigh*...

Wonder Acute felt down after being unable
to make her signature daikon radish dish...
